name: What should I prepare before starting a custom remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before starting a custom remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting a custom remodeling project, gather your ideas, inspiration photos, and a clear understanding of your functional needs and desired aesthetics. Establish a realistic budget, including a contingency fund for unexpected costs. Think about your preferred timeline and any specific requirements or concerns you have. This preparation will help us better understand your vision and provide a more accurate proposal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before starting, prepare your ideas, inspiration, functional needs, desired aesthetics, and a realistic budget, including a contingency fund.
